semantics.supported: Equivalent capability is implemented and tested; this does not imply API-shape compatibility unless explicitly stated.
semantics.partial: A bounded subset or adapter-backed equivalent exists, with the stated gaps.
semantics.missing: No shipped equivalent capability was found.
semantics.not-applicable: The member is library infrastructure rather than a product capability.

claim.note: Cockroach Crawler and Cockroach Browser do not claim Puppeteer 25.5.0 parity. This matrix is the exact implementation backlog.

crawler.note: Library-specific event and error object shapes are not browser capabilities.

cockroachBrowser.note: Cockroach Browser has its own typed errors, receipts, and lifecycle events.

crawlerAdapter.note: The adapter preserves its own error contract instead of impersonating Puppeteer classes.

categories.title: Browser launch, attach, disconnect, and process metadata

crawler.note: Optional Chromium launch and CDP attachment exist inside governed crawl mode; there is no public Puppeteer-compatible browser lifecycle object.

cockroachBrowser.note: Headless/headed Chromium launch and explicit CDP attachment are available; Firefox, WebDriver BiDi, and Puppeteer API identity are not.

crawlerAdapter.note: The adapter opens and closes injected backend sessions; executable, CDP, browser download, and process control remain backend-owned.

categories.title: Contexts, pages, tabs, popups, and targets

crawler.note: Crawler browser mode creates an isolated context per crawl, but does not expose contexts, target discovery, or general tab lifecycle.

cockroachBrowser.note: Bounded tabs, popups, locks, and isolated sessions are available; Puppeteer Target and BrowserContext objects are not API-compatible.

crawlerAdapter.note: The foundation exposes bounded tab actions through an injected backend, not Puppeteer Target or BrowserContext instances.

crawler.note: Crawler does not install, enumerate, or automate browser extensions.

cockroachBrowser.note: The current Cockroach Browser capability registry does not claim extension lifecycle or extension realm automation.

crawlerAdapter.note: No extension actions exist in the adapter backend contract.

crawler.note: Crawler does not install, launch, inspect, or uninstall PWAs.

cockroachBrowser.note: Cockroach Browser does not currently expose PWA lifecycle actions.

crawlerAdapter.note: No PWA lifecycle action is defined by the adapter.

crawler.note: A bounded viewport is configurable, but window bounds, screen creation, and window state are unavailable.

cockroachBrowser.note: Viewport and headed sessions are supported; direct window bounds and virtual screen management are not claimed.

crawlerAdapter.note: Viewport is accepted at session creation; window and virtual-screen commands are not exposed.

crawler.note: Crawler does not grant page permissions.

cockroachBrowser.note: The current capability registry intentionally exposes effect policy, not arbitrary browser permission grants.

crawlerAdapter.note: Permission mutation is outside the adapter contract.

categories.title: Navigation, history, reload, and lifecycle waits

crawler.note: Governed navigation, redirects, wait conditions, and bounded selector clicks are available in crawl mode; Page/Frame API parity is absent.

cockroachBrowser.note: Navigate, reload, back, forward, bounded waits, tabs, and history inspection are runtime capabilities.

crawlerAdapter.note: The adapter's safe slice includes navigate, back, forward, reload, wait, and history inspection on owned sessions.

categories.title: Selectors, locators, element handles, and waits

crawler.note: CSS, XPath, adaptive relocation, open shadow flattening, and bounded waits exist, but Puppeteer Locator/ElementHandle semantics do not.

cockroachBrowser.note: Semantic refs, CSS, XPath, open shadow roots, and same-origin frame targets exist; Locator filters, mappers, and handle APIs remain gaps.

crawlerAdapter.note: Actions can use backend semantic refs, CSS, or XPath; the adapter does not emulate Puppeteer Locator or ElementHandle objects.

crawler.note: Crawler browser options support bounded selector clicks and trusted hooks, not a complete interactive form API.

cockroachBrowser.note: Click, double-click, fill, type, press, select, check, uncheck, hover, focus, drag, and bounded scroll are implemented.

crawlerAdapter.note: All existing Cockroach Browser action names are catalogued, but mutating actions are disabled by default and require creator-owned action/effect policy plus backend approval enforcement.

crawler.note: Crawler does not expose raw keyboard control.

cockroachBrowser.note: Bounded key down/up/insertText and higher-level press/type exist; Puppeteer's full keyboard layout semantics are not claimed.

crawlerAdapter.note: Keyboard actions can be delegated only after explicit creator opt-in; no Puppeteer Keyboard object is provided.

categories.title: Mouse, drag, wheel, and touch input

crawler.note: Crawler does not expose low-level pointer or touch devices.

cockroachBrowser.note: Bounded in-viewport mouse, wheel, drag, hover, and click exist; a public touch device surface is missing.

crawlerAdapter.note: Mouse and drag actions are catalogued for opt-in delegation; touch actions are missing.

categories.title: JavaScript evaluation, realms, handles, and exposed functions

crawler.note: Trusted host hooks can evaluate bounded functions; agent/MCP input cannot submit JavaScript and JSHandle/Realm APIs are absent.

cockroachBrowser.note: Policy-gated expression evaluation exists; handles, realms, exposed functions, and new-document script lifecycle are not API-compatible.

crawlerAdapter.note: Evaluate can be delegated only when creator policy enables execute authority; no handles or realms cross the adapter boundary.

categories.title: File chooser, upload, download, and dialogs

crawler.note: Crawler does not expose interactive choosers, uploads, downloads, or dialog acceptance.

cockroachBrowser.note: Controlled uploads/downloads and explicit dialog handling are implemented with roots, budgets, policy, and approvals.

crawlerAdapter.note: Upload/download actions can be explicitly enabled, but the adapter supplies no Puppeteer FileChooser/Dialog object and leaves approval/evidence enforcement to the backend.

crawler.note: Readable same-origin iframe flattening is bounded; cross-origin frames and workers are unavailable.

cockroachBrowser.note: Readable same-origin frames are observable and targetable; worker lifecycle and evaluation are missing.

crawlerAdapter.note: Backend frame targets can be passed through actions; workers are not represented.

crawler.note: Crawler does not expose a browser accessibility tree API.

cockroachBrowser.note: Semantic snapshots and accessibility audits exist, but they are not Puppeteer's Accessibility.snapshot contract.

crawlerAdapter.note: Semantic snapshots can be delegated; no dedicated accessibility-tree method is exposed.

categories.title: Device, viewport, media, locale, timezone, CPU, and network emulation

crawler.note: Coherent named identity, viewport, locale, timezone, and user-agent settings exist; device, media, CPU, offline, and network emulation are incomplete.

cockroachBrowser.note: Viewport, locale, timezone, color scheme, user agent, headers, and proxy configuration exist; CPU/network/device/vision emulation is incomplete.

crawlerAdapter.note: Viewport, locale, timezone, and color scheme are accepted at session creation; the remaining emulation surface is missing.

categories.title: HTTP requests, responses, authentication, routing, and network waits

crawler.note: Governed GET/HEAD proxying, DNS pinning, redirects, blocking, XHR capture, and response metadata exist; arbitrary request continuation/response objects do not.

cockroachBrowser.note: Redacted network records and policy-bounded abort/static fulfill routes exist; Puppeteer HTTPRequest/HTTPResponse and arbitrary interception controls do not.

crawlerAdapter.note: Network inspect/export and bounded routes can be delegated; raw request/response object access is deliberately absent.

crawler.note: Host-only browser cookies and explicit storage-state files are supported under crawler policy; general cookie APIs and partitions are restricted.

cockroachBrowser.note: Explicit cookie and same-origin storage read/write plus encrypted checkpoints exist behind credential effects and policy.

crawlerAdapter.note: Cookie/storage actions are catalogued but disabled by default and remain backend-governed credential effects.

crawler.note: PNG/JPEG screenshots and PDF artifacts ship with explicit directory, byte ceiling, media type, and SHA-256 evidence.

cockroachBrowser.note: PNG/JPEG screenshots, paired visual-semantic captures, and PDFs are evidence-backed runtime capabilities.

crawlerAdapter.note: Screenshot, PDF, and paired capture are included in the safe adapter action slice.

crawler.note: Crawler does not expose browser tracing.

cockroachBrowser.note: Playwright trace archives are implemented; this is not Puppeteer's tracing API or trace format contract.

crawlerAdapter.note: Trace start/stop are catalogued for explicit opt-in delegation.

crawler.note: Crawler does not collect JavaScript or CSS coverage.

cockroachBrowser.note: The current capability registry does not claim code coverage.

crawlerAdapter.note: Coverage actions are not defined.

categories.title: Heap snapshots, runtime metrics, console, and security metadata

crawler.note: Bounded rendered output and response evidence exist; heap snapshots, browser metrics, and console object APIs are missing.

cockroachBrowser.note: Bounded console records, performance observations, security observations, and asset audits exist; heap snapshots and exact Puppeteer metrics are missing.

crawlerAdapter.note: The foundation does not yet expose audit, console, metrics, or heap operations through its three-method backend contract.

crawler.note: Crawler does not record browser video.

cockroachBrowser.note: Session video recording exists; Puppeteer Page.screencast and ScreenRecorder controls are not API-compatible.

crawlerAdapter.note: Session creation can request backend video recording, but no streaming recorder object is exposed.

crawler.note: A CDP endpoint can be selected for internal browser acquisition, but raw protocol sessions are not public.

cockroachBrowser.note: Explicit CDP attachment launches a governed session; arbitrary CDP send/event authority is not exposed.

crawlerAdapter.note: Raw protocol access is intentionally outside the adapter contract.

crawler.note: Crawler does not emulate Bluetooth or answer device prompts.

cockroachBrowser.note: Cockroach Browser does not currently claim Bluetooth emulation.

crawlerAdapter.note: No Bluetooth action is defined.

crawler.note: Crawler supports its own bounded CSS/XPath/adaptive selectors, not runtime registration of arbitrary query handlers.

cockroachBrowser.note: Cockroach Browser supports fixed semantic/CSS/XPath targeting, not custom handler registration.

crawlerAdapter.note: The adapter does not register code-bearing selector handlers.

crawler.note: Cockroach Crawler's MCP server is a package control surface, not Puppeteer's page WebMCP tool discovery API.

cockroachBrowser.note: Cockroach Browser's MCP server is observation-first and does not claim page WebMCP parity.

crawlerAdapter.note: Page WebMCP discovery and execution are outside the adapter contract.
